title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: the acceptance holder must be the booking party for a remittance
content:
## Rule
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product a remittance is applied to an acceptance only when the acceptance's holder is also the booking party of the booking the goods travel under. For an acceptance held by a party other than that booking party, the desk books no remittance and the amount applied is 0.00.

## Records compared
| Record | What is read |
|---|---|
| the acceptance | the customer holding it |
| the booking the goods travel under | the customer who is its booking party |

## Condition → outcome
| Holder of the acceptance compared with the booking party | Remittance |
|---|---|
| the same customer | may be applied |
| a different customer | no remittance is booked; amount applied 0.00 |

## Worked case (hypothetical parties)
A freight forwarder is the booking party of a booking; the dangerous-goods acceptance on that booking is held by the cargo owner. The acceptance's holder is not the booking party, so no remittance is booked on that acceptance.
